UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Bench at Nagpur dated 28.10.2021 passed in Writ Petition Nos.5351 of 2019 and 5492 of 2019, the Agriculture Produced Market Committee (APMC), Nagpur has preferred the present Special Leave Petition Nos.988-989 of 2022 to the extent by which the High Court has directed the petitioner/Market Committee to pay the compensation with respect to the land in question considering the market value of the land as on 01.01.2014.

sentences.text: The original writ petitioner of Writ Petition No.5492 of 2019  original land owner has also preferred Special Leave Petition No.7518 of 2022 against that part of the judgment and order passed by the High Court by which the High Court has refused to grant the relief in favour of the original writ petitioner with respect to the lapse of the acquisition proceedings.

Today, when the present Special Leave Petitions are taken up for further hearing,
Shri Vinay Navare, learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the Market Committee and Shri Dama Sheshadri Naidu, learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the original writ petitioners/original land owners have stated at the Bar that both the parties have settled the dispute amicably and the contd..
- 3 - The Agricultural Produce Market ... vs The State Of Maharashtra on 17 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130205543/
2 terms of Settlement dated 16.03.2023 has been entered into, which is placed on record and which is directed to be taken on record.
Both the learned senior counsel have prayed to dispose of the present Special Leave Petitions in terms of settlement/Settlement Agreement dated 16.03.2023.
In view of the above, we dispose of the present Special Leave Petitions in terms of Settlement Agreement dated 16.03.2023, which is placed on record.
All the parties are directed to act as per Settlement Agreement dated 16.03.2023.

The Special Land Acquisition Officer now to determine the compensation as per the settlement, at the earliest and preferably within a period of four months from the date of receipt of the present order.
With this, the present Special Leave Petitions stand disposed of, in terms of the above.
Pending application(s) shall stand disposed of.
(NEETU SACHDEVA)
(NISHA TRIPATHI)
